changelog.en: v2.1.1: fixes everything build 37 feedback reported: music player rebuilt to the Apple Music reference — cover-tinted warm gradient background, dead songs auto-skip to the next track instead of stopping at 0:00; mini player 40pt, joined with the menu into one true-glass unit at the bottom edge, selected tab pink pill + blue glyph; Huya no-playable-address fixed at the root (parser offset bug), rooms should resolve again; live portrait room re-laid out per Pure Live (48pt avatar, bubble danmaku, follow/refresh/share bottom bar); music and video sources re-tested by real playback — dead ones removed (lzm, Huya CMS source), Meting (NetEase) and vkeys QQ added, CMS HTML play pages now resolve their embedded m3u8; Emby gains Continue Watching. Real-device glass translucency, Huya live playback and Emby resume still need on-device verification; landscape music player still overflows, next round.
changelog.tw: v2.1.1：修 build 37 回報的問題：音樂播放器按 Apple Music 重做——封面取色暖色漸變背景、播不起來的歌自動跳下一首、不再停在 0:00；迷你播放器 40pt，與選單連成一塊真玻璃整體貼底邊，選中 tab 粉紅 pill＋藍字；虎牙全源無地址已修（解析偏移 bug），房間應能出地址；直播間豎屏按 Pure Live 重排（48 頭像、氣泡彈幕、底部關注／刷新／分享）；音樂源與影視源逐個真播重測：失效的刪掉（lzm、虎牙資源），新增 Meting（網易）與落月 QQ，CMS 播放頁解析內嵌 m3u8；Emby 增加「繼續觀看」。真機玻璃透光、虎牙實播、Emby 續播仍待真機驗證；橫屏音樂播放器仍溢出，下一輪修。
changelog.zh: v2.1.1：修 build 37 反馈的问题：音乐播放器按 Apple Music 重做——封面取色暖色渐变背景、播不起来的歌自动跳下一首、不再停在 0:00；迷你播放器 40pt，与菜单连成一块真玻璃整体贴底边，选中 tab 粉红 pill + 蓝字；虎牙全源无地址已修（解析偏移 bug），房间应能出地址；直播间竖屏按 Pure Live 重排（48 头像、气泡弹幕、底部关注/刷新/分享）；音乐源与影视源逐个真播重测：失效的删掉（lzm、虎牙资源），新增 Meting（网易）与落月 QQ，CMS 播放页解析内嵌 m3u8；Emby 增加“继续观看”。真机玻璃透光、虎牙实播、Emby 续播仍待真机验证；横屏音乐播放器仍溢出，下一轮修。
